name: Bobbahn Donnstetten
editorial: Eight descriptions cleaned; fourteen displayed fares for solo and pair occupancy; age rules sourced; 106 dated overrides through February 2027. Source says weather and ski operation may close the run.

calendar.nuance: Open times are provisional in poor weather and when the ski lifts operate. Published holiday exceptions included.

pricing: Operator displays 14 fares across one, six and ten rides for child, adult and two-person combinations, without effective date. Under-eights require accompaniment; confirm fare at ticket office.
